notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for a successful QueryAttributeOwnership invocation reported through the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation interaction. The adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. The owner publishes one attribute and subscribes to service reports; the requester subscribes to both attributes, queries ownership, and the scenario verifies the exact service name/type, success, type-37 object-designator and type-1 attribute-set arguments, type-34 null return marker, empty exception, serial zero, reliable delivery, and the resulting informAttributeOwnership and attributeIsNotOwned callbacks. It checks all eight standard report parameters are present, but does not decode the inherited HLAfederate parameter value. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library; it makes no provider-specific or implementation-state assertion.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::queryAttributeOwnership(ObjectInstanceHandle, AttributeHandleSet), standard service-reporting controls, and FederateAmbassador ownership-result and receiveInteraction callbacks
